reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking local vibrational heterogeneities to phonon scattering and reduced thermal conductivity, but the claim of a specific 30% improvement in RMSE is arbitrary and not mechanistically justified.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion (RMSE >30% deviation), though the practical measurement of LDOS in a combinatorial film is extremely challenging and not fully detailed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful as it proposes a concrete, high-throughput experimental framework to validate a predictive approach, directly addressing the research question on identifying low-κ HEA compositions.
